实跑证据（会话 bhklwkwu，34 回合）暴露的三个耦合问题，同一轮修完。定位结论（先查后改）：intent 解析本身是对的（parseIntent 探针实测「去特里坎家」→action:move、target:特里坎家），根因全在 handleIntent 与 act() 的控制流，没有动 intent 解析范围。① handleIntent 的 case "move"/"look" 在模块模式下无视 tryResolveModuleScene() 的返回值、一律 return false——那句 docstring 早就写着「返回值在两个调用点都被丢掉」，写了没改，移动成功了也被报成没处理，继续往下走到战斗检测；两处改成如实转发返回值。② act() 里 `this.combatActive || 攻击词` 的判断把「战斗还没结束」和「这句话是攻击」混成一件事，非攻击输入（移动解析失败、纯叙述、聊天）只要没被 handleIntent 接住就被判成打人；改成只看输入本身是否像攻击，combatActive 不再单独构成理由——但 combatActive 本身不在这里被清掉，不产生攻击判定不等于战斗结束，落点仍是 LLM 叙事分支。③ aliveEnemies()（战斗旗/还手/退出战斗/自由行动战斗判定四处共用）原先不按场景过滤，加 `(scene_id ?? position) === 当前场景` 判断（pos==="unknown" 时不过滤，避免大量约定俗成用占位场景名、从未真正注册场景的测试夹具整批消失）；同时把 act() 里的自由行动战斗块与 handleAttack() 各自的内联敌人过滤都换成复用 aliveEnemies()，消灭三处重复实现。加 combat-escape-and-scene-scope.test.ts（9 条，三个症状各三条：正确行为/目标行为错误的对照/文本相似但合法不误报）。变异检验：三处分别还原成 bug 版本，对应测试精确变红（第一次测试设计漏了两个盲区又补上——症状 2/3 的场景里有真实模组 NPC，泛指攻击的伤害可能落在未被断言追踪的 NPC 身上让 mutation 白测，改用「压根没有攻击判定发生」和挑一个模组未安排 NPC 的场景来消除歧义），Copy-Item 还原后回归 9/9。顺带发现并保留：aliveEnemies() 的 scene_id/position 双轨兜底与 pos==="unknown" 豁免都是运行中发现的真实测试夹具兼容性问题，不是猜的

fix dev-server.ps1 caller hang: switch from Start-Process (plan A) to WMI Win32_Process.Create (plan B). Measured 2026-08-30: the previous Start-Process -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput/-Error avoided the orphan-process problem but left the caller itself blocked -- one real run showed 8m33s between server start and the first request, with the PID already alive and server-out.log already populated, first misdiagnosed as "start only starts the server, an empty-looking log is expected" when the caller had simply never returned. Root cause: -NoNewWindow shares the caller's console but does not remove the child from the caller's own Job Object; the caller waits for the whole process tree to exit, not for the console to close, so a new console changes nothing. Tried plan A first as instructed (drop -NoNewWindow): measured twice (via `bun run dev-server:start` and via a direct `powershell -File ... start` call) that the script itself returns in under a second while the calling shell tool still hangs until forcibly killed at the timeout -- confirms the Job Object theory rather than assuming it. Fell back to plan B: Win32_Process.Create runs via WmiPrvSE.exe, outside the caller's Job Object; measured the caller returning in ~2s across two independent start/stop cycles. Trade-off: Win32_Process.Create is a thin CreateProcess wrapper and does not understand shell redirection, so it has to launch through `cmd.exe /c ... > out 2> err`, making the WMI-created process the cmd.exe wrapper rather than the real bun.exe server; Start-DevServer polls (up to 5s) for the bun.exe child of that wrapper PID and stores the real server PID in .dev-server.pid so status/stop keep acting on the actual listening process, and additionally records the wrapper PID in the new .gitignore'd .dev-server-wrapper.pid so Stop-DevServer can explicitly kill both instead of relying on cmd.exe self-terminating once its child dies. Verified end to end, twice: start returns promptly, server-out.log/server-err.log both get real content, GET /api/config returns 200, status reports running, stop removes both PID files and leaves zero bun.exe/cmd.exe processes and no listener on 3099; also verified the already-running guard and the stop-when-not-running path. Not a test-count change (this is an external PowerShell process script, not something bun test exercises); no new bun tests. typecheck exit 0; bun test 2455 (unchanged), 158 files unchanged; preflight 12/12.

fix pendingConfirm cross-PC leakage: it must know who asked. Measured 2026-08-30 (session lcmj2joi): round 7 p1's sentence opened a compound-move re-ask ("KP is waiting to confirm whether to move first"), round 8 p2 said something unrelated ("ask Phoebe about the bar party") and that got silently consumed as the answer to p1's question, moving nobody and dropping p1's pending question. Root cause: pendingConfirm was a single session-level field that only recorded "is something pending", never "who asked". Decided (and implemented) two different rules for the two kinds, because they are different in scope: compound-move is one PC's own action deciding whether to move first, so it should only accept that PC's answer -- replaced the single field with pendingCompoundMove: Map<pcId, {originalInput, originalIntent}>, keyed per PC so two PCs can each have their own unanswered question without clobbering each other; a different PC acting while one is open now executes its own intent normally and gets a system reminder that pcId X still has an open question, rather than being silently swallowed as an answer -- explicitly documented and accepted risk: if that PC never acts again the entry just sits there (no expiry/timeout logic added, that needs its own design decision this round doesn't make). leave is a party-wide decision (whether to end the whole investigation), so it deliberately stays PC-agnostic -- kept as a plain pendingLeaveConfirm boolean, any PC's next line can confirm or cancel it. This also reverts the previous round's unification of both kinds into one PendingConfirm field/type; that unification's stated reason ("structurally impossible for two pendings to fight") only held in a single-PC model -- with multiple PCs, a party-wide leave and a per-PC compound-move being open at once is a normal state, not something to prevent. Reproduced the reported leak with the deterministic harness (game-session-run-harness.ts) rather than trusting the sim's own table (which was internally inconsistent about which round the scene actually changed) -- 3 new scripted scenarios in game-session-run-harness.test.ts: p1 opens a compound-move question, p2 acts with an unrelated sentence (no scene name in it, to keep this test isolated from the separate over-triggering issue) and its own action executes normally with a reminder shown, p1 then answers and moves correctly; same-PC round-trip regression (opening and answering as the same p1 still works); leave confirmed by a different PC (p2) than the one who opened it still ends the session, confirming the party-wide rule. Also updated compound-move-reask.test.ts's two pendingConfirm assertions to read the new pendingCompoundMove/pendingLeaveConfirm fields (behavior unchanged, single-PC case). Mutation check: made the compound-move consumption pick any pending value instead of the one keyed by the acting pcId, the cross-PC scenario went red (scene incorrectly moved from the unrelated PC's line) while the other 8 tests in the file stayed green; Copy-Item restored. fix two clue-match bugs that were the direct cause of a 7-round sim abort (analysis/sim/2026-08-31-barn-action-anchor-abort.md): three searches in a row denied without a single dice roll. Bug 1: SEARCH_VERB/SEARCH_VERB_ANY were missing "翻查" -- round 7's real sentence ("陆川仔细翻查餐桌下面...") failed the adjacency check purely because that verb wasn't in the list, even though "翻找"/"翻阅" (close synonyms) already were. Added "翻查" plus a small curated set of same-register synonyms (翻看/扒开/掀开/摸索/找找/瞧瞧) with an explicit note on why the list stays bounded (no more additions without real sim evidence). Bug 2: uniqueAbbrevs() (move-util.ts) is designed for move matching, where Chinese place names have a 2+ char head noun at the end ("维森酒吧"->"酒吧"); reused as-is for clue matching, its shortest-unique-substring algorithm ate the shared verb prefix before finding a boundary ("侦查卫生间"->"侦查卫") and, worse, sliced straight through the indivisible two-character word "卫生" to produce the meaningless suffix "生间" (round 6's real sentence used a different verb than the description, "检查" vs "侦查", so exact-substring matching never even got a chance and fell through to this broken abbreviation). Did not touch move-util.ts's uniqueAbbrevs itself (regression redline: it's shared with move matching) -- instead strip search verbs from the candidate keys/rivals before calling it, plus a small addition to also register the whole stripped noun as its own candidate when unique on its own (uniqueAbbrevs' truncation loop requires strictly-shorter lengths, so an already-exactly-2-char stripped noun like "餐桌" would otherwise never get a candidate at all). This surfaced a second-order regression caught by an existing test ("侦查卫生间已经搜过了" incorrectly matched clue_drugs): the negation/completed-context window in isRejectedMention looks a fixed 8 characters after the matched key's own end, and a truncated abbreviation ("卫生", missing its trailing "间") shifts that window just enough to miss "已经搜过了". Fixed by checking negation against the full stripped noun ("卫生间") instead of the truncated abbreviation whenever that full noun is literally present in the input, falling back to the abbreviation's own position otherwise (round 7's "餐桌" case, whose source phrase never appears verbatim, is unaffected). Added clue-match-verb-and-abbrev-fix.test.ts (12 tests) using the sim report's exact round-6/round-7 sentences plus targeted unit tests for each bug and the negation regression. narrow clue-match deny (scheme B): only deny when the player clearly points at something absent, not whenever wording just fails to line up. Previously decideClueMatch() denied any time the player gave "specific" content that matched nothing, including content that was really just filler. Concretely: GameSession.getSuggestions()'s own action-anchor suggestion "仔细搜查这里" stripped down to "仔细这里" (4 chars, clears the >=2 no-signal threshold) even though "这里" doesn't name any location -- the anchor recommended an action guaranteed to deny. Added stripLocationFillers() (这里/那里/那儿/四周/周围, exported alongside stripSearchVerbs) and applied it wherever content-signal length is judged: matchSceneClues()'s internal no-signal check, and decideClueMatch()'s entry-level short-circuit. Also widened SEARCH_VERB_ANY (the full-string strip used for that same signal computation, and for task 1's uniqueAbbrevs preprocessing) with a small set of manner adverbs that commonly precede search verbs in this data (仔细/认真/再次/好好) -- deliberately not added to the anchored SEARCH_VERB used by hasSearchIntent, since an adverb alone isn't a search action and there's no evidence it should count as one for that check. Widened ENTRY_VERB_PREFIX to accept one optional adverb before the verb, still anchored and still only one verb -- "仔细搜查这里" now short-circuits to fallback at the entry level (same treatment as a bare verb, one click still gets one real result) instead of falling through to matchSceneClues and coming back "ask" (a clarifying question defeats a one-click action-anchor button) or "deny". Verified explicitly that a genuinely-absent object ("拖车房搜「保险柜」", not mentioned by any clue in that scene) still denies -- the narrowing only removes filler-only false positives, it doesn't turn deny into a rare/soft outcome. Added clue-match-deny-narrowing.test.ts (9 tests): stripLocationFillers unit coverage, the fallback outcome for the action-anchor's own suggestion text at both the decideClueMatch and matchSceneClues layers plus an end-to-end GameSession round trip proving a real check result (not the old "这里没什么特别的" deny line), the 保险柜 preservation case at both the decision and end-to-end layers, and a regression pair (bare 侦查 still fallback, a real location hint still resolves).
